purpose: Prepare bounded downstream artifacts before an upstream gate resolves so a later PASS, repairable FAIL, or BOUNDARY can be consumed quickly without granting execution, promotion, scheduling, or acceptance authority early.

derived_state.name: PREPARED_NOT_AUTHORIZED
derived_state.meaning: Preparation artifacts exist for a still-unresolved branch and may reduce post-RETURN setup time.

PASS.activation_gate: Observed upstream outcome is PASS, prepared_against digest/version still matches, all existing authority gates are satisfied, and the successor wins normal semantic dedup plus normal PIN ownership.

FAIL_REPAIR.activation_gate: Observed upstream outcome is FAIL/REPAIR_REQUIRED, failure matches the prepared defect class, prepared_against digest/version still matches, and the repair successor passes existing dedup and PIN authority.

BOUNDARY.activation_gate: Observed upstream outcome is BOUNDARY and the exact boundary class/evidence basis matches. Preparation may package evidence but cannot bypass the boundary.

triggers: acceptance vectors or gate schema materially change
the authority/source ref used by preparation is superseded
the observed outcome belongs to a different branch class
prepared evidence basis is explicitly invalidated or contradicted
invalidation.rule: On any trigger, preparation is not executable and not promotable. Recompute from current evidence or discard it as cache-like derived work; never mutate CURRENT to make the preparation fit.

expected_value_rule.formula: EV_saved_idle_ms = probability_branch * idle_ms_saved_if_hit - preparation_cost_ms - probability_invalidation * invalidation_rework_cost_ms
prepare_when: preparation does not require premature authority
the branch is evidence-backed rather than invented filler
resource cost is bounded relative to currently available worker capacity
skip_when: preparation would duplicate an already durable successor
preparation requires destructive or irreversible action
preparation would weaken a safety, privacy, capability, verification, or human-decision gate

transition_rules: PREPARED_NOT_AUTHORIZED + matching PASS -> candidate successor may enter existing semantic dedup and claim flow
PREPARED_NOT_AUTHORIZED + matching FAIL_REPAIR -> bounded repair candidate may enter existing semantic dedup and claim flow
PREPARED_NOT_AUTHORIZED + matching BOUNDARY -> evidence/boundary packet may be consumed; boundary remains authoritative
Any prepared branch without matching observed upstream outcome -> remain non-authoritative and do not execute
truth_boundary: This is a derived preparation/cache contract. It creates no queue, scheduler, worker family, liveness truth, execution authority, verification authority, acceptance authority, CURRENT owner or promotion authority.
